title: Data security

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: receiving datasets into a restricted quarantine environment before downstream use
detecting portions that may contain sensitive information
presenting candidate sensitivity markings for human confirmation or editing
requiring explicit authorization before release from quarantine
moving only approved data into a separate environment where broader authorized use is permitted
applying access controls and ontology mappings after governed release

scope_model.analysis_loop: ingest into quarantine -> detect possible sensitive fields -> present evidence to authorized governor -> confirm or edit markings -> approve explicit release -> transfer only approved portions -> enforce access policy -> map into ontology -> audit every transition
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: quarantine unreviewed external datasets by default
separate automated sensitivity suggestions from authoritative labels
require a human/governance release decision before broader use
preserve raw, marked, and released states with immutable provenance
apply least-privilege access separately to quarantine and released environments
keep authorization and privacy decisions outside language-model memory

independent_claim_themes: quarantine of a dataset with restricted copying/moving/sharing
sensitive-data detection and human sensitivity marking
authorized release into a second database
access based on authorization and sensitivity markers
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope depends on controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and jurisdiction. This record is an engineering research abstraction only.

use_for: ontology ingestion with human release gates
